title: Surat Thani 37-STC high-resolution drone baseline

web_preview.derivation: Downsampled web preview derived from the Drive PNG source; raw GeoTIFF is not served by Vercel.

qa.raw_metadata_reason: Connected Drive download is limited to 256 MB while the GeoTIFF is 3.33 GB; do not infer CRS, GSD, band count, transform or flight date from the preview or folder name.

scientific_guard: Do not derive an erosion/accretion rate from one drone epoch.
Do not call folder label 20-05-2569 a verified flight date until acquisition metadata confirms it.
Do not align the preview to Sentinel-2 or project geometry until GeoTIFF CRS/transform QA is complete.
Do not compute drone NDVI until the raw band configuration confirms a NIR band.
Use the preview as visual high-resolution spatial context only.
